context_separation: Same independent reviewer who froze this candidate's cold and informed runtime diagnostics, now conducting an informed design-only review. Read the complete opening fields, relevant scope/research/art contracts and prior review criteria; authored independent findings rather than inheriting approval. Verified the supplied digest using sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false. No browser run, source-code inspection, canonical edits or runtime changes. Prior reports remain unchanged.

progression.reason: The opening consistently orders one route commitment, persistent partner response, receiver Look, destination/invitation, then the existing intrusion and separate prison theft. Look neither moves Zip nor promises reachable territory. Fresh completion/Skip/Escape enters controls with a summary; saved-checkpoint replay returns to its prior checkpoint/view. First-beat replay clears local choice/inspection, while Previous restores the inspected result non-destructively. No later step is authorized.
progression.counterexample: Skip/Escape before choice, while Look is pending, or during its invitation must never fabricate a choice/inspection. In saved replay all three exits return to the captured checkpoint/view, not fresh controls. Return from intrusion via Previous must restore the actual selected inspected destination; replaying the first beat must clear only presentation state and re-establish the Look requirement.

concept_fidelity.reason: The causal contract preserves light/gesture communication, an intact voice module through rupture, a separate later theft and prepared machine speech distinct from natural voice. Route choice and inspection have no learning outcomes, credit or mastery claims. Personal invitations motivate a future relationship without expanding the learning task or accessible map.
concept_fidelity.counterexample: Muted/static presentation must show the module intact after separation and absent only after theft. The invitation must not imply the earlier light path used or restored speech. Repeated Look, Previous, Skip and alternate-path replay must not create or replace learning first choices, commands or credit.

decision_necessity.reason: One activation remains the sole route decision. The additional Look has a distinct information function: framing either the shaded companion seat or the paired-light train-view balcony and its personal invitation. It is a bounded attention action, not route reconfirmation or conceptual assessment. Holding the result addresses the previously weak discovery opportunity; whether the action feels worthwhile remains a runtime question.
decision_necessity.counterexample: Look must expose a concrete destination and partner intention not already exhausted by the activation view. If it merely renames Continue, repeats the same shot/caption, requires choosing the route again, or can be bypassed by generic advance while pending, the design has not been implemented. Both direct and semantic route activation must reach the same selected result.

attention_and_access.reason: Opening surfaces explicitly preserve route and pending Look controls through orbit/zoom/recenter, including behind-camera edge cues, semantic keyboard activation and 44px touch targets without travel. The focus transition moves from partner response to receiver, despite the shared initial surface anchor. Enlarged-text, screen-reader and static equivalents preserve causal meaning. Existing reduced-motion stepping remains the exception to ambient advancement, not an optional companion to automatic dwell.
attention_and_access.counterexample: At 360px/200% text, orbit behind the receiver and recenter: its named Look action must stay reachable without covering Zip or falsely appearing on another object. Paused/reduced-motion response must reach a settled inspectable state without waiting for animation. After Look, reduced motion must still require explicit stepping; ordinary dwell must not race the invitation. Held movement/Enter must not carry through as accidental inspection or advancement.

research_application.reason: The revision applies the cold relationship/discovery finding through persistent consequence, a functionally distinct place and a specific shared intention. It retains the selected reference's functional depth, material/shadow hierarchy and inhabited-world direction within the existing receiver island. It does not substitute more territory, decorative density or a new generator for the small action-response-discovery chain.
research_application.counterexample: An empty seat or paired lights that appear only as caption nouns, identical destinations differentiated solely by labels, or an unrelated decorative camera cut would not meet the design. A fresh observer must identify the partner contribution, answered place and reason to care before being told intent. This permission does not establish that they will want to continue.
